headline_marked: Over 100 [[garment factories shut]] amid protests and clashes in Savar, Ashulia
headline: Over 100 garment factories shut amid protests and clashes in Savar, Ashulia
summary: Workers are demanding a minimum monthly wage of Tk 30,000, leading to widespread road blockades and violent clashes with police.
details: More than 100 garment factories in Savar and Ashulia have declared holidays today following intense labor unrest. Workers are protesting to demand a minimum monthly wage of Tk 30,000.

The unrest escalated into violent clashes between police and protesters in several areas, including Ulail, Fulbaria, Ghoshbagh, Nischintapur, and Narsinghpur. Protesters blocked roads and hurled brickbats at police forces.

Police used sound grenades and tear gas to disperse the crowds. In one incident, protesters set fire to a vehicle used by the officer-in-charge of Savar Model Police Station, who was seriously injured.
Four journalists were assaulted by protesters while covering the story in the Padmar Mor area. One of the injured journalists is the president of the Savar Press Club.

Authorities have arrested more than 30 people, stating that third-party groups are exploiting workers' emotions to destabilize the country. Investigations are underway to check for links to banned organizations.

headline_marked: Tahsif murder: [[Friend Disha remanded again]] as police probe possible arguments
headline: Tahsif murder: Friend Disha remanded again as police probe possible arguments
summary: A Dhaka court has placed Jarika Tasnim Disha on a fresh three-day remand in connection with the murder of her friend, former Bangladesh Air Force officer KM Tahsif Souri. Police are investigating potential disputes between the two.
details: Jarika Tasnim Disha, a friend of the deceased KM Tahsif Souri, has been placed on a three-day remand by a Dhaka court. This comes as police continue their investigation into the murder of the former Bangladesh Air Force officer.

The court ordered the fresh remand after police requested an additional seven days for interrogation. Investigators are seeking to determine if Disha and Tahsif had any arguments or emotionally charged conversations on the day of the incident.

Disha reportedly told investigators that she was with Tahsif on the night of October 27, visiting various locations including a restaurant and a motorcycle garage. She also accompanied him on his motorcycle to several other places.

While Disha has provided some information, investigators note that she has tactfully avoided answering several questions. Her statements will be cross-checked with those of Ahmed Shahriar Reza Dip, another friend of Tahsif who is also in police custody.

Tahsif's mobile phone records show he had multiple calls with Disha. The investigation aims to uncover the full circumstances surrounding his death, identify any other potential suspects, and recover crucial evidence.

Tahsif's father filed a murder case on October 31, alleging his son was murdered and his body dumped in a river to conceal the crime. Disha was arrested on November 1, and Dip was taken into custody earlier.
